messages:
Maya: Quick sync — we still don't have a clear way to show in Console why a request was routed to a fallback model variant. customers ask for auditability when they see different latency/quality.
Ajay: +1. they want per-request reason: capacity / region / tier / policy.
Leo: Are we ok putting that decision in the response headers? `X-Redwood-Routing` feels useful for debugging but might expose internal routing rules.
Sophia: header would be easiest for apps to consume, but security review flagged potential info leak about infra. Also concern about extra bytes on hot paths.
Maya: Thoughts on alternatives: 1) enrich tracing spans with routing fields (span tags), 2) emit an audit log record per routed request, 3) add optional response header behind tenant flag.
Ajay: Traces are ideal for observability, but customers using our hosted API want something immediate in their app logs without tracing. Audit log is heavier and harder to correlate.
Leo: Implementation detail: if we put routing keys in spans we need to ensure every router/gateway attaches `routing.decision` attribute before any fanout to avoid racey missing fields.
Sophia: Also: we need sampling. Can't attach full decision payload for 100% of requests in spans — cost. Proposal: default: sample 1/1000 to traces, always record aggregated counters and a sampled audit event, and have an opt-in tenant setting to enable `response_header: true` for debug windows.
Maya: That sounds pragmatic. UX ask for Console: a per-tenant routing timeline with drilldowns on a single request showing trace + headers + fallback chain (original model -> fallback variant -> fallback region).
Ajay: For the drilldown we need these fields: `route_id`, `decision_reason`, `chosen_variant`, `fallback_chain`, `capacity_snapshot` (region pools). We should agree on names.
Leo: API proposal for trace tags (proto names): `routing.route_id`, `routing.reason`, `routing.variant`, `routing.fallbacks` (csv). For response header: `X-Redwood-Routing-Decision: route_id=...,variant=...,reason=capacity`
Sophia: PII check: ensure none of these include tenant identifiers or customer-sensitive flags. route_id should be opaque UUID. No policy rules in header.
Maya: Also think about quotas: when quota triggers fallback to cheaper model, Console should show "quota-based downgrade" so CS can explain to customers. That mapping must be deterministic and visible.
Ajay: Internal API debate: Should router return the raw policy evaluation string like `tier_check_failed: reserved_slots=0`? I vote no — keep it coarse: reason in {capacity,quota,region,latency-sla,manual-override}.
Leo: Agreed. Coarse reasons are safer for logs and easier to surface. Keep detailed policy traces only in internal audit events (sampled).
Sophia: UX: add a toggle in Console "Show routing diagnostics" which when enabled for a tenant will: enable header, increase sampling to traces, and surface a routing timeline per request. Default off.
Maya: Action items: @Ajay - write up proto/field names and small API change for router header + trace tags. @Leo - instrument router to emit sampled audit events with policy debug in internal log topic. @Sophia - wire a Console toggle and draft UI mock for drilldown.
Ajay: Will do. I'll post a short API diff and example header.
Ajay: Example header / log sample: ```
X-Redwood-Routing-Decision: route_id=9f3d2a7b-1a2b-4c3d-8e5f,variant=redwood-v2-q4_8,reason=quota
{ "audit_event": true, "route_id":"9f3d2a7b...", "decision":"quota", "policy_debug":"tenant_quota_exceeded: 0/1000" }
```
Leo: I'll add `routing.*` tags to spans and ensure we set them before the request is proxied to the serving pool. Need to careful with async fanout.
Sophia: I'll mock the Console panel. Key pieces: histogram of reasons, map by region, recent sampled requests list with "open trace" button. Also a "download audit log" link for a time window.
Maya: One more: telemetry/alerting. Product wants an anomaly alert when fallback rate > 2% for > 10min for enterprise tenants. We'll need metric `tenant.routing.fallback_rate` and a dashboard tile.
Ajay: ok I'll add the metric emission (`fallback_count` / `total_requests`) and tag by tenant/tier/region/variant.
deploy-bot: trace-instrumentation branch merged to staging at 1772506000 :sparkles:
Maya: Thanks. Let's keep the header opt-in and defaults conservative. Follow-ups on the API PRs and Console mock tomorrow.
Sophia: noted, will add accessibility notes to the mock.
Leo: FYI I'll post a short runbook on how to debug routing decisions from logs vs traces.
Maya: Great thread — closing for now. If anyone wants to champion the tenant toggle UX, @Sophia please.
